Do you move from Montreal to Edmonton as well? Yes. We explain the basic carrier protection and any additional Declared Value Protection options available for your shipment before your move date. What is the best time of year to move from Edmonton to Montreal? Late spring and early fall can provide milder conditions, but scheduling, shipment size, and weather all affect the plan. Winter moves on the Edmonton–Montreal corridor should allow flexibility for severe weather. Can I get a written estimate for my Edmonton to Montreal move? Yes. We provide written estimates based on an in-home or virtual inventory assessment, with the expected price range and included services documented before moving day. Review the official QC requirements for health coverage, a driver's licence, vehicle registration, and other residency records before the move. Transition rules and deadlines depend on the program and your circumstances. What should I do before the movers arrive? Defrost your fridge 24 hours ahead, disconnect appliances, label boxes by room, and set aside medications, chargers, and documents to carry yourself.
